retrievalProfile.description: A warm, intimate male portrait featuring a shallow depth of field and organic, hand-drawn white typography overlaid on a dark foreground element.
excludeWhen: clean sans-serif corporate typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a man with mid-length hair looking off-camera, set against a blurred warm wooden interior. The subject wears a dark navy t-shirt which serves as a high-contrast canvas for white, informal hand-lettered text in the lower third of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed away from the viewer creates a candid, introspective mood.
Warm background tones (browns/tans) contrast with the cool navy blue of the subject's shirt.
The white hand-drawn text is anchored to the dark mass of the shirt for maximum legibility.
Shallow depth of field separates the sharp subject from the cluttered but soft-focus background.
coreInvariants: Earthy color palette dominated by brown and navy

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned centrally but leaning slightly right, occupying approximately 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes are the primary anchor, with the bright white text acting as a secondary anchor in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, follows his gaze to the right, then drops down to the bright text in the lower left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left and right corners provide soft-focus negative space that frames the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and wood tones in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue of the t-shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the hand-lettered typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation in the background with higher value/clarity on the subject's face; high value contrast between the shirt and the text.

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight mimicking a paint marker or chalk
Open counters and slightly shaky, organic strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'K' and 'R' have extended, expressive legs
The 'E' and 'A' are simplified and slightly rounded
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of large, blocky hand-drawn caps with a smaller, more cursive-leaning sub-header.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the organic, tactile feel of the original lettering.
Provides the necessary texture and informal weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium close-up portrait of a man with mid-length blonde-brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a dark navy t-shirt, sitting in a warm wooden interior with soft, shallow depth of field background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn white lettering in the bottom left corner, ensuring the text overlaps the dark area of the shirt for contrast. Use an informal, slightly messy marker style.

verificationChecks: Is the text legible against the shirt?
Does the background have a warm, blurred wood texture?
Is the lighting natural and soft on the face?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Any specific brand logos on the shirt
postGenerationChecks: Check that text is white and hand-drawn style.
Ensure the subject is looking away from the camera.
Verify the background is a warm-toned interior.
Confirm the composition uses the lower-left for text placement.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait of [Subject] + [Dark Clothing] + [Warm Wood Interior] + [Shallow Depth of Field] + [White Hand-Lettered Overlay in Bottom Left]
